meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 装上后，做安全审计时 Claude 会组建 3 名漏洞猎人 + 2 名验证工程师的团队：猎人找可疑问题，工程师证明哪些真的能利用；按可利用性定严重性，出 PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK 报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 “security-research” 等触发词、要求做安全审查或漏洞审计，或使用 /security-research 时触发；需团队模式开启并在主会话中。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计这个仓库。
say.note: 会组建 5 人团队并行审计并出报告。

say.text: security review 这个 PR，证明漏洞能否实际利用。
say.note: 会验证每个发现并给修复建议。

say.text: vulnerability audit 一下这个目录，给 PoC。
say.note: 会生成含攻击路径、PoC 和最小修复的报告。

howto.what_en: Claude forms a 5-person team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) that audits code, proves which findings are truly exploitable, ranks severity by exploitability, and outputs a report headed PASS, PASS WITH FINDINGS, or BLOCK.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security-research' or on a request for a security review / vulnerability audit, or when /security-research is used. Requires team mode enabled and the main session.

say_en.text: Run a security-research audit on this repository.
say_en.note: A 5-member team audits in parallel and reports.

say_en.text: Security review this PR and prove which flaws are actually exploitable.
say_en.note: Engineers verify each candidate and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Vulnerability audit this directory and give me a PoC.
say_en.note: Report includes attack path, PoC, and minimal fix.
